description:
One-click accept of a **held** decision (accountant) — posts the AI's proposal.

A person's accept overrides the soft guardrails. An agent's is refused (403) unless
the row is ``agent_acceptable`` or an expense receipt. Closed period, sealed year,
unknown account: 409/422. The row flips ``held → posted`` (again: 409);
``accepted_by_kind`` records the channel (``mcp`` over MCP).

Optional ``body``: ``expense:receipt:item:`` needs
``employee_id`` + ``category_id``; ``autopost:capitalize:`` needs
``fixed_asset_category_id`` when the hold has none, and ``needs_split_source`` a
``reclassify_from_account_code``.

anyOf.description: Optional ``POST /autopost-decisions/{id}/accept`` body; omit it for other kinds.

name: accept_autopost_decision
